title: Bionic Commando: Rearmed
provenance: Reported by DeepBlade (highball#375, 2026-10-17), Apple M2 Max, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal environment: crashes on launch or shows a black screen. The log has two loader lock waits at start and the game's Direct3D 9 going through DXVK. Not verified by the maintainer. DeepBlade again (highball#428, 2026-10-26): runs after NVIDIA's PhysX System Software was installed in the environment.
notes: Runs once NVIDIA's PhysX System Software is in the environment, which the recipe now installs (the reporter of highball#375 and #428 confirmed it on an M2 Max, 2026-10-26). Without it the game crashed on launch on DXVK and on Wine's own Direct3D alike: it starts a second copy of itself, loads PhysX's loader and cooking DLLs from its folder but never PhysXCore, and raises its own fatal error. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash on launch, on DXVK and on Wine's own Direct3D alike (highball#375)
knownIssues.cause: NVIDIA's PhysX System Software missing from the environment: PhysXCore never loads (confirmed by the fix)
knownIssues.fix: the recipe installs the PhysX component (Highball's Windows components, from the version after 0.10.22). By hand now, NVIDIA's PhysX_9.23.1019_SystemSoftware.exe run with Run a Windows program in the environment
